article.title: Parties to suits for foreclosure, sale and redemption
article.content:
85Parties to suits for foreclosure, sale and redemption

Rep. by the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (5 of 1908), s. 156 and V Schedule.
Note: the sub-headings “4Suits for Foreclosure, Sale or Redemption” above this section carry the marker(s) footnoted here.
For the repealed provisions, as re-enacted, see (Act 5 of 1908), Sch. I, Order XXXIV.
